purpose: Frozen source-held-out production-versus-candidate fallback comparison. Failed native/WASM numerical gates remain release failures; this diagnostic replay measures their downstream effects without changing candidate or thresholds.

policy.classifier: Existing RGB mixture classifier for both methods
policy.solver: Unchanged automatic configuration, 10 seconds, no uncertainty trials
policy.selection: Keep supported production crop; otherwise use candidate fields through unchanged locator only if outline-supported and all four corners observed. No per-image winning fit selection.
policy.identicalCropPolicy: Reuse the exact production fit when selection is unchanged; refit both arms for changed crops. Compare final editable exports and visual photo fidelity; derived-mask agreement is not artwork ground truth.
policy.missingCropPolicy: Record failures; no manual rescue or case replacement.
policy.visualReview: Inspect all selected source photos and all distinct crop/mask/export pairs; record false gaps, lost motifs and crop contamination independently of acceptance.
